items.summary: Bristol-Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) reported new 56-week Phase 3 data for Camzyos in pediatric obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. The updated results show sustained efficacy over 56 weeks in children with symptomatic oHCM who were previously treated in shorter-term studies. Safety findings from the extended Phase 3 period were described as consistent with the known profile that supported the earlier pediatric approval.
